newsitem.title: USA: Equifax at ease with '97 view $1.45/shr.
newsitem.headline: Equifax at ease with '97 view $1.45/shr.

text.p: Equifax Inc Chief Executive Officer Daniel McGlaughlin said Wednesay he supports Wall Street's consensus estimate of 1997 earnings per share of $1.45.
The company had 1996 earnings of $1.22 a share.
In a presentation to analysts at Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc's annnual institutional conference, McGlaughlin noted the Wall Street consensus figure for 1997 and said, "We're comfortable with that."

In his presenation, McLaughlin reviewed last December's announcement that the company plans to split in two, separating its more profitable credit services segment from its slower-growing insurance services operation.
He said Equifax plans a tax-free transaction for shareholders and is awaiting a decision on that proposal from the Internal Revenue Service, which is expected in mid-July.
If the IRS approves, McLaughlin said, the split will come on January 30, 1998, or soon after.
McLaughlin told Reuters that Equifax shareholders would receive one share of the new insurance services company for each 10 shares they hold.
